title: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name
question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.

prediction.error: RuntimeError('Own Anchor/raw produced noSQL; terminal generation failure')
prediction.query_budget_protocol: 3 independently per Anchor/raw/full; maximum9, not sharedRQ4B3

access_trace.sql:
SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS sessions_held,
       SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_enrollment,
       MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee,
       MAX(d.FEE) AS max_fee,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_with_info,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO='N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_without_info
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE d.TERM_CODE LIKE '%JA%'
GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY s.SPONSOR_NAME;
